Picocomputer 6502 for Analogue Pocket
=====================================

Always begin at the documentation:
https://picocomputer.github.io/


Install
-------

Copy everything into the same folder structure on a microSD card.
The Cores, Platforms, Saves, and Assets folders merge with the ones
already on the card; nothing here replaces another core's files.

The Pocket needs firmware 2.3 or later. Open the core from the
Pocket menu under openFPGA.


ROMs
----

6502 software is distributed as files ending with ".rp6502". Put
them in Assets/rp6502/common/ on the card, and pick one from the
list shown when the core opens. Find them on Discord, which has a forum
for ROMs, or on itch.io under the RP6502 tag:

    https://discord.gg/TC6X8kTr6d
    https://itch.io/games/tag-rp6502

Assets/rp6502/common/ is also the working directory, so a program
opens a file beside its ROM by its plain name. The working directory
cannot be changed on the Pocket. The Pocket has no installed ROMs, so
each ROM runs from its file.


Saves
-----

A program saves through SAVE:, and those files are stored in
Saves/rp6502/common/. The Pocket does not create this folder, so the
package has a .keep file in it, which keeps the folder in the zip file.
